[[Allura]] is one of several Elonian [[Pilgrimage|pilgrims]] attempting to reach [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]] even after dying on the journey.

==Locations==
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[The Desolation]]
***{{NPC location|The Ruptured Heart}} (only during the following quest)
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Crystal Desert]]
***{{NPC location|Skyward Reach}} (after completion of the following quest)

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*[[The Desolation]]
**[[Pilgrimage]]

==Dialogue==
In the Ruptured Heart:
:''"I had heard that the path was easy to follow, but who knew that the landmarks would be so obscure? I was told that you could see [[Augury Rock]] from across the desert, but the heat masked our visibility. We got turned around and then the dunes all began to look the same..."''

In Skyward Reach:
:''"Were I still alive, this sight would bring a tear to my eye. Thank you for guiding me to my promised land."''

==Notes==
*Allura's name can sometimes appear on-screen when holding Alt while running toward the area with the four [[Bleached Bones]] even while the quest isn't active.
